title: $100 a month into Mastercard since 2006 is now worth this
caption:
$100 every month into Mastercard since 2006.
Today that would be worth about {dca:MA:2006-05-25} (price growth only, no dividends).
comment: Could you put away $100 a month? 👇
sources: Mastercard price history, Yahoo Finance (split-adjusted), at render time

scenes.say: One hundred dollars a month, into Mastercard, starting in 2006.
Back then, Mastercard was a card network.
Today, those monthly payments would be worth about {dca:MA:2006-05-25}.
Small, boring, every month. That's how wealth is built.
